summary: E1: executor = ruviform_exec::OfflineJob worker thread + bounded std::sync::mpsc::sync_channel command queue (default cap 64). JobExecutor (ruviform#744) deliberately not adopted — JobOrchestrator is already the single-writer scheduling authority; per-job executor primitives would duplicate it. Recorded in docs/adr/issue-518-job-system.md.

E2: orchestrator split — drive_step is the scheduler quantum (one stage transition or one demand render); drive/run preserved as Progress loops. DriveOutcome::Progress added. Scheduler worker round-robins candidates so cancel/retry/grant commands interleave between demands.

issue-518-job-system: async non-RT scheduler (OfflineJob+bounded queue), deterministic cost model, project render_policy persistence v15, workspace RenderDispatch adapter + cli/mcp-poc wiring (synvelis#518)

E3: crash-resume defect found — a crashed job kept state=Rendering with crashed=true, so the worker candidate picker would re-drive it forever, violating explicit-resume contract. Fixed at orchestrator boundary: drive_step returns DriveOutcome::Crashed for crashed jobs, pick_candidate excludes crashed, new resume_crashed clears flag + records ReceiptKind::Resumed without synchronous drive. Async pin: async_pol06_crash_requires_explicit_resume.

E4: JobScheduler::call() blocks on reply_rx.recv() — commands issued while the worker is parked inside a gated executor render cannot be answered until release, deadlocking tests that await replies first. Fix: tests issue such commands from helper threads and release the gate before awaiting replies. This is a test-shape constraint, not a scheduler defect.

E5: wait_terminal treated SchedulerError::QueueFull as fatal, but queue-full is transient admission control (bounded queue backpressure), not worker death. Fixed: wait_terminal retries QueueFull until deadline. async_scheduler_bounded_queue_reports_queue_full pins the typed rejection itself.

E6: cost model — JobCostEstimate::default() placeholders replaced by deterministic estimate_cost(recipe, scope, measured inputs) in render_job/cost.rs; merge_estimate combines caller-declared estimate with model floor element-wise max before budget/grant gates. Caller explicit estimates still honored as declared slot; model supplies the floor. Deterministic, no wall-clock/RNG.

E7: ruviform_exec::OfflineJob is !Sync (holds mpsc Receiver). Workspace RenderDispatch adapter wraps JobScheduler state in Mutex so the composition root stays Send+Sync for GateDeps.render. JobSystem::headless() is the production composition root wired into synvelis-cli host and mcp-poc.

E8: project render_policy persistence — serde-default optional field on Project, identity migration step, SCHEMA_VERSION 14->15. Three leased test pins (cb01_variant.rs, md_a.rs, tim_02_smf.rs assert SCHEMA_VERSION==14) updated 14->15 with coordinator approval (msg_3e7143e90682, msg_77da6b863ccb); test names/provenance unchanged.

Verification: cargo test auxiliary — synvelis-render all suites pass incl. 9 new async pol01/pol06 pins (30 rcp03 tests total); synvelis-project all suites pass; synvelis-workspace all suites pass. mise canonical verification + prek + review-protocol pending at PR time; recorded in evidence/sv518/verification.md.
